Position: - Data Scientist

Location: Dallas, TX/NJ (Day 1 onsite)

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Design AI Solutions: Architect and design scalable, reliable, and high-performance AI solutions leveraging the capabilities of Google Cloud Platform. Design, develop, and implement AIML, NLP, transformer, SLM (Specialized Language Models) models and algorithms.
• AI Model Development: Lead the development and deployment of machine learning models using GCP's AI and ML services (e.g., AutoML, AI Platform, etc.). Design, develop, and implement NLP, Machine learning, transformer, SLM models
• Productionize models – model training, model deployment, model serving, model monitoring. Optimize Generative AI models for improved performance, scalability, and efficiency.
• Integration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to seamlessly integrate AI solutions into existing systems and processes.
• Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize cloud infrastructure for AI workloads, ensuring cost-effectiveness and performance.
• Data Pipelines: Design and implement robust data pipelines for AI model training and inference.
• Security and Compliance: Ensure that AI solutions meet security and compliance requirements, working closely with the security team.
• Documentation and Best Practices: Create and maintain documentation for architecture, design patterns, and best practices related to AIML development and maintenance on GCP.
• Stay Updated: Stay abreast of the latest trends and advancements in AI and GCP to continuously improve our offerings. Conduct research to stay up to date with the latest advancements in AIML, machine learning, and deep learning techniques, and identify opportunities to integrate them into customer products and services.
• Function as a technical or project lead and while mentoring junior engineering talent

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Plans strategies, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation. Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

For example, you may be hired as a GS-05, but if the position has career progression to GS-11, then you may move from a GS-05 to a GS-11 in as little as three years.

HQ - Direct File

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Serves as subject matter expert and advisor across the Service, including all levels of leadership and staff on building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation improving customer experience products, directly reporting to the CIR complex. Leads the implementation and refinement of Direct File projects, specifically the customer experience by making data-driven decisions, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences to create best in class customer experience products. Manages workload and resources and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Leads, guides, and facilitates complex, cross-organization, cross-functional projects and engage partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, identify and assess internal customer experience product pain points and areas of potential improvement: and in leverages deep user understanding with the goal of improving the customer experience.
• Develops relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs and ensure customer experience product are established with clear and intuitive customer interactions to develop a high-quality experience for the CIR complex. Understands, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structured and unstructured data, analyzes, evaluates, monitors, and measures the development and execution of solutions to improve internal and external customer experiences across critical touchpoints. Develops and recommends that include anomaly detection, business outcomes, including establishing standards that impact multiple organizations and IRS locations. Considers the implications of emerging technological developments, economic and social trends, in the development of process and quality improvement best practices and methodologies. Ensures that systems/processes are developed with quality to deliver value to customers and achieve the desired organizational results, including increased productivity, effectiveness, and sustainability.
• Conducts planning, development, coordination, and implementation of an entire project, including workload estimates, methodology, computer systems specifications for assuring the adequacy of project design. Provides key input to leadership and team members and ensures all project tracking and documentation aspects are completed accurately, thoroughly, and timely by reviewing all aspects of project, including customer and taxpayer experience that impact multiple organizations and/or IRS locations. Conducts and manages periodic audits of quality requirements. Analyzes audit results to ensure appropriate measures quality standards and operational definitions are in place. Prepares and delivers formal audit reports. Monitors and reports on the outputs from the quality assurance and audit processes. Establish and maintains metrics formaking data-driven decisions for improved customer experience products; measure, monitor and analyze metrics to ensure IRS is investing time and money on customer experience activities and initiatives with the highest impact to customer segments.

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Plans strategies, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation. Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.

Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

• Plans strategies, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation. Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.

Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Plans strategies, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation. Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

HQ - Direct File

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Plans strategies, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation. Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

This position has career progression. If you are selected at a grade level lower than the full working level, you may be non-competitively promoted as your career progresses. For example, you may be hired as a GS-05, but if the position has career progression to GS-11, then you may move from a GS-05 to a GS-11 in as little as three years.

Vacancies Will Be Filled In The Following Specialty Areas

HQ - Direct File

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Serves as subject matter expert and advisor across the Service, including all levels of leadership and staff on building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation improving customer experience products, directly reporting to the CIR complex. Leads the implementation and refinement of Direct File projects, specifically the customer experience by making data-driven decisions, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences to create best in class customer experience products. Manages workload and resources and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Leads, guides, and facilitates complex, cross-organization, cross-functional projects and engage partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, identify and assess internal customer experience product pain points and areas of potential improvement: and in leverages deep user understanding with the goal of improving the customer experience.
• Develops relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs and ensure customer experience product are established with clear and intuitive customer interactions to develop a high-quality experience for the CIR complex. Understands, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structured and unstructured data, analyzes, evaluates, monitors, and measures the development and execution of solutions to improve internal and external customer experiences across critical touchpoints. Develops and recommends that include anomaly detection, business outcomes, including establishing standards that impact multiple organizations and IRS locations. Considers the implications of emerging technological developments, economic and social trends, in the development of process and quality improvement best practices and methodologies. Ensures that systems/processes are developed with quality to deliver value to customers and achieve the desired organizational results, including increased productivity, effectiveness, and sustainability.
• Conducts planning, development, coordination, and implementation of an entire project, including workload estimates, methodology, computer systems specifications for assuring the adequacy of project design. Provides key input to leadership and team members and ensures all project tracking and documentation aspects are completed accurately, thoroughly, and timely by reviewing all aspects of project, including customer and taxpayer experience that impact multiple organizations and/or IRS locations. Conducts and manages periodic audits of quality requirements. Analyzes audit results to ensure appropriate measures quality standards and operational definitions are in place. Prepares and delivers formal audit reports. Monitors and reports on the outputs from the quality assurance and audit processes. Establish and maintains metrics formaking data-driven decisions for improved customer experience products; measure, monitor and analyze metrics to ensure IRS is investing time and money on customer experience activities and initiatives with the highest impact to customer segments.

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level.
• Plans strategies, building on industry best practices and lessons learned to transform the internal and external customer experiences by keeping up to date with innovations in data science from both academic and industry sources and identifies opportunities for implementation. Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.

Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload, resources, and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Responsible for engaging partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, by communicating analytic solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including during executive-level and/or cross-agency meetings, in a clear and effective manner using oral and written communications. Identifies and assesses internal customer experience pain points and areas of potential improvement utilizing data-driven decisions.
• Develops initial initiation, planning, implementation, controlling, modifying and executing of all or part of an entire project, including such tasks as formulation of workload estimates for program segments, specification of the methodology to be used, preparation of appropriate specifications and procedures, and review of computer systems specifications and materials and instructions needed for assuring the adequacy of the project's design. Reviews the results of the project. Evaluates and monitors measures and solutions to improve internal and external customer experience across critical touchpoints. Develops best practices, including establishing standards.
• Identifies and assesses relevant data sources' validity and reliability to meet project needs. Collates, cleans, transforms, analyzes, and integrates structures and unstructured data from various sources in preparation for analysis. Applies data mining, and statistical theory and methods to test hypotheses using structured and unstructured data.

Manages workload and resources and sets program priorities in alignment with the Strategic Plan. Leads, guides, and facilitates complex, cross-organization, cross-functional projects and engage partners across the Service in efforts to improve understanding of customer needs, identify and assess internal customer experience product pain points and areas of potential improvement: and in leverages deep user understanding with the goal of improving the customer experience.

Ensures that systems/processes are developed with quality to deliver value to customers and achieve the desired organizational results, including increased productivity, effectiveness, and sustainability.

Qualifications

Federal experience is not required. The experience may have been gained in the public sector, private sector or Volunteer Service. One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-time work is considered on a prorated basis. To ensure full credit for your work experience, please indicate dates of employment by month/year, and indicate number of hours worked per week, on your resume.

You must meet the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement:

BASIC REQUIREMENTS FOR ALL GRADES: A Bachelor's or higher degree in Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position. OR Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown above, plus additional education or appropriate experience.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE:GS-14: To be minimally qualified for this position you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-13) in the Federal Government. Specialized experience includes: Experience with program/project management analytical and evaluative methods, techniques, and tools, both qualitative and quantitative. Experience working on projects or studies of broad scope and evaluating data results to develop and recommend strategies and solutions. Experience in assisting or leading the design, development, or maturity of an enterprise-wide program, including experience identifying, developing and implementing long-range goals to develop and advance the mission and vision of a program, specifically for customer experience digital service enhancements. Experience with verbal and written communication skills sufficient to organize and summarize large amounts of information and document or articulate problems, issues, outcomes, and recommendations, and prepare reports, presentations, and/or briefings.

AND

MEET TIME IN GRADE (TIG) REQUIREMENT: You must meet applicable TIG requirements to be considered eligible. To meet TIG for positions above the GS-05 grade level, you must have served at least one year (52 weeks) at the next lower grade (or equivalent) in the normal line of progression for the position you are applying to. Advancement to positions up to GS-05 is permitted if the position to be filled is no more than two grades above the lowest grade held within the preceding 52 weeks.

AND

TIME AFTER COMPETITIVE APPOINTMENT: By the closing date (or if this is an open continuous announcement, by the cut-off date) specified in this job announcement, current civilian employees must have completed at least 90 days of federal civilian service since their latest non-temporary appointment from a competitive referral certificate, known as time after competitive appointment. For this requirement, a competitive appointment is one where you applied to and were appointed from an announcement open to "All US Citizens".
